const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"set -u
fail=0
pack_root='evidence/quality/repair-window-18-20260923/orchestration'
pack_count=0
pack_bytes=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel want_sha want_bytes; do
  dst="$pack_root/$rel"
  pack_count=$((pack_count + 1))
  if [ ! -f "$dst" ]; then echo "PACK_MISSING $dst"; fail=1; continue; fi
  got_sha=$(sha256sum "$dst" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  got_bytes=$(wc -c < "$dst")
  pack_bytes=$((pack_bytes + got_bytes))
  if [ "$got_sha" != "$want_sha" ] || [ "$got_bytes" != "$want_bytes" ]; then echo "PACK_MISMATCH $dst"; fail=1; fi
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' .ai/task/repair-w18-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json)
cmp -s .ai/task/repair-w18-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json "$pack_root/orchestration-pack-manifest.json" || { echo MANIFEST_COPY_MISMATCH; fail=1; }
catalog_count=0
while IFS= read -r src; do
  rel=${src#.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window18-20260923-candidate-catalog/}
  catalog_count=$((catalog_count + 1))
  cmp -s "$src" "$rel" || { echo "CATALOG_MISMATCH $rel"; fail=1; }
done < <(find .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window18-20260923-candidate-catalog -type f | sort)
migration_dst='evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/4847d321cc828a85d29b12b3c05a399eee35a700288d9ade838f8b84a443f58f.json'
cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window18-20260923-migration.json "$migration_dst" || { echo MIGRATION_MISMATCH; fail=1; }
pub='evidence/quality/repair-window-18-20260923/publication'
for name in PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json ADJUDICATION-R0.json ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json; do cmp -s ".ai/task/repair-w18-20260923/$name" "$pub/$name" || { echo "PUBLICATION_MISMATCH $name"; fail=1; }; done
